projects.title: Chicago Reimbursements Site
bullets: Built an auto-updating scraper pipeline in Jupyter Notebook tracking city employee reimbursement payments for public transparency.
Added continuous integration to keep the dataset current, then restructured the site's layout after early readers found the raw tables confusing.

projects.title: Baby Names IOC
bullets: Designed a survey and used R to analyze the gender split of baby names across recent years.
Rebuilt a cluttered ggplot for-loop into simpler charts after peers struggled to compare name trends at a glance.

projects.title: Thomas Frank Spurs
bullets: Analyzed a football manager's tenure using Jupyter Notebook, translating match statistics into readable visual summaries for casual fans.

leadership.title: Founding Organizer
bullets: Organized a recurring night where classmates presented data projects to non-technical peers, coaching presenters to lead with takeaways over methods.
Noticed peers' charts were technically sound but hard to read, and began sketching simpler layouts before finalizing analysis.
